propositions: Cloud's three whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) have no test exercising pagination beyond a single page, despite using opaque cursor-based pagination with nextPageToken and isLast termination conditions
Existing test coverage in test_acli_cross_mixin_binding.py only feeds single-page payloads with isLast=True, leaving cursor advance logic and multi-page recovery untested
The same defect class (pagination truncation) has shipped and been fixed three separate times on the DC/shared side, creating risk of recurrence on Cloud's untested code paths

A new test module with 27 passing tests and 1 strict xfail validates cursor advance, multi-page recovery (250 items across 3 pages), independent termination conditions (isLast alone, exhausted cursor alone), short-page non-termination, and detects a live defect (repeated cursor token causes infinite loop)
Structural AST guard extending to adapters/jira/*.py prevents future unpaginated whole-project POST readers from being added silently on Cloud, closing the class on both deployments
